notes: Full-feature mobile app (PWA): the phone page now has Expenses (view + record + search), Suppliers (purchased/paid/owed balances), Purchase Orders (create + view), Reports (today/month summary, top items, 7-day trend) and Settings (store info), reached via the new Home quick actions and nav tabs. New /api/expenses, /api/suppliers, /api/purchase-orders, /api/reports, /api/settings endpoints, plus an offline-capable service worker for secure-context installs (Tailscale/web).
